query:
SELECT id,
                organization_id,
                COALESCE(email, '') AS "email!",
                invited_role::text AS "invited_role!",
                invitation_type::text AS "invitation_type!",
                target_user_id
         FROM organization_invitations
         WHERE token_hash = $1
           AND status = 'PENDING'
           AND expires_at > now()
         LIMIT 1
